description: Terminology concept blocklist: surface forms whose auto-coded SNOMED concept IDs are suppressed in UK primary care context.

rules.comment: Generic mention in notes; do not auto-code to a specific named operation.
Symptom phrasing should not be coerced to broad malaise.
Mechanical wording in patient advice; not malignant neoplasm of nervous system.
FIT is a test (Faecal Immunochemical Test), not a seizure.
